title: File:Dervis-pasa Bajezidagic Mosque - Medreska Street number sign in Podhum, Mostar - Bosna i Hercegovina (2026)-bs.jpg
description: Blue street name sign with house number 1 for Medreska Street, mounted on a stone wall at the entrance to the Derviš-paša Bajezidagić Mosque in the Podhum neighborhood of Mostar, photographed in October 2026. Originally built in the late 16th century (1592–1597), the mosque was completely mined and destroyed in 1993 by Croatian Defence Council (HVO) forces during the War in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and was rebuilt and reopened in 2004. The architectural ensemble is designated a National Monument
